actors.name: Donald Trump
actors.blurb: President Donald Trump is dominating right-wing media coverage following his keynote appearance at the Republican Midterm Convention in Dallas, where he promised a controversial $5,000 cash dividend to American adults if Republicans retain Congress. His administration is simultaneously pushing major executive actions on cattle ranching, energy infrastructure, and census reform while facing legal challenges over judicial appointments and voting rules.

actors.name: JD Vance
actors.role: Vice President of the United States
actors.blurb: Vice President JD Vance delivered a high-profile keynote address to close the RNC Midterm Convention in Dallas, centering his speech on nuclear family values and a national birthright. His prominent convention role has drawn significant commentary positioning him as a primary contender to inherit the MAGA mantle for a 2028 presidential campaign.
